originalAtlasPrompt: Create a production 2D cutout puppet layer atlas using the attached adult Siyeon character as strict identity, expression, clothing, book and pose reference. Preserve the face and the exact costume. Clean 1990s cel anime line art. Transparent RGBA, NO glow, NO shadows outside the silhouette, NO grey haze, hard clean edges. Perfect 2x2 grid in an overall portrait 2:3 canvas. Four equal portrait cells, same full-character scale and exact coordinates in all cells, character fits with 6% clear padding. Top left: ONLY torso, legs, book, back hair and stationary arm, with head and one foreground gesturing arm removed; extend the neck/collar and sleeve underneath to allow seamless overlap. Top right: ONLY head, face, front hair and small neck overlap in its original full-character position. Bottom left: ONLY foreground arm and hand with complete sleeve and shoulder overlap, at the original full-character position. Bottom right: duplicate of top-right head in exactly same position, same expression but eyes naturally closed for a blink (if reference eyes are closed, make this alternate head eyes gently open). Never enlarge parts or center them independently. No labels, lettering, grid lines, panels, background or complete extra character. Layers reassemble by overlaying the 4 equal cells. Hair/neck edges and shoulder need comfortable overlap for subtle independent animation.
revisionPrompt: Edit the 2x2 puppet atlas: transparent background, remove glow/grid, remove viewer-left arm from body, keep book arm, connected foreground arm, matching open and closed-eye head at body scale and registration. Preserve identity/costume. Corrected atlas heads were accepted; full-body cells were rejected in favor of dedicated body layers.
bodyPrompt: Technical cutout animation BODY layer ONLY. Keep exact costume, shoes, skirt, back hair, book and book-holding arm. Remove head/front hair and one complete foreground arm, retaining collar and rounded shoulder fabric overlap. Full body and feet, true transparent PNG, no glow/grid/text.
selection: 12 revised head/blink pairs; 3 dedicated body masters; 5 gesture source atlases. Source rectangles, destination registration and anchors in src/character-rigs.json. Never render rejected atlas cells.
outputs: sources.json and revisions.json preserve generation paths; manifest.json lists shipped file hashes and silhouette bounds
